title: Segmentation fault after deregister an NF
body:
Hello, I've found that NRF breaks down with a segmentation fault after deregistering an NF.

The sequence is: 
**1. Start the NRF and another NF, in my example, the ASUF:**
```
nrf      | Deploying component: 'nrf-1'
nrf      | Open5GS daemon v2.4.3-7-g340b23a
nrf      | 
nrf      | 01/31 11:38:44.722: [app] INFO: Configuration: '/open5gs/install/etc/open5gs/nrf.yaml' (../lib/app/ogs-init.c:129)
nrf      | 01/31 11:38:44.722: [app] INFO: File Logging: '/open5gs/install/var/log/open5gs/nrf.log' (../lib/app/ogs-init.c:132)
nrf      | 01/31 11:38:44.722: [sbi] INFO: nghttp2_server() [172.22.0.12]:7777 (../lib/sbi/nghttp2-server.c:144)
nrf      | 01/31 11:38:44.722: [app] INFO: NRF initialize...done (../src/nrf/app.c:31)
ausf     | Open5GS daemon v2.4.3-7-g340b23a
ausf     | 
ausf     | 01/31 11:38:45.158: [app] INFO: Configuration: '/open5gs/install/etc/open5gs/ausf.yaml' (../lib/app/ogs-init.c:129)
ausf     | 01/31 11:38:45.158: [app] INFO: File Logging: '/open5gs/install/var/log/open5gs/ausf.log' (../lib/app/ogs-init.c:132)
ausf     | 01/31 11:38:45.159: [sbi] INFO: nghttp2_server() [172.22.0.11]:7777 (../lib/sbi/nghttp2-server.c:144)
ausf     | 01/31 11:38:45.159: [app] INFO: AUSF initialize...done (../src/ausf/app.c:31)
nrf      | 01/31 11:38:45.160: [nrf] INFO: [f736adb4-8281-41ec-ba1b-9d7dbdc3610b] NF registred [Heartbeat:10s] (../src/nrf/nf-sm.c:192)
ausf     | 01/31 11:38:45.160: [ausf] INFO: [f736adb4-8281-41ec-ba1b-9d7dbdc3610b] NF registred [Heartbeat:10s] (../src/ausf/nf-sm.c:198)
```

**2. After that, we subscribe with another NF to the AUSFs. Using _curl_ the effect is the same.**
```
curl --http2prior-knowledge -i -X POST "http://172.22.0.12:7777/nnrf-nfm/v1/subscriptions" -H "accept: application/3gppHal+json" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{ \"nfStatusNotificationUri\": \"http://172.22.0.1:8081/ausf-notification-data/v1/notification\", \"subscriptionId\": \"subcription-to-AUSF\",  \"reqNfType\": \"AUSF\"}"
HTTP/2 201 
server: Open5GS v2.4.3-7-g340b23a
date: Mon, 31 Jan 2022 10:40:51 GMT
content-length: 229
content-type: application/json
location: /nnrf-nfm/v1/subscriptions

{
        "nfStatusNotificationUri":      "http://172.22.0.1:8081/ausf-notification-data/v1/notification",
        "subscriptionId":       "42905cc4-8282-41ec-81ec-5f3f07911e04",
        "validityTime": "2022-02-01T11:40:51.576282+01:00",
        "reqNfType":    "AUSF"
```
**3. And finally, unsubscribe the AUSF**
```
curl --http2prior-knowledge -i -X DELETE "http://172.22.0.12:7777/nnrf-nfm/v1/nf-instances/f736adb4-8281-41ec-ba1b-9d7dbdc3610b"curl: (52) Empty reply from server
```

**The response is empty because the NRF breaks down, here is the error trace:**
```
nrf      | 01/31 11:40:51.575: [nrf] WARNING: [subcription-to-AUSF] NF should not send SubscriptionID (../src/nrf/nnrf-handler.c:217)
nrf      | 01/31 11:41:27.281: [nrf] INFO: [f736adb4-8281-41ec-ba1b-9d7dbdc3610b] NF de-registered (../src/nrf/nf-sm.c:207)
nrf      | /open5gs_init.sh: line 96:    11 Segmentation fault      (core dumped) ./open5gs-nrfd
nrf exited with code 139
```
